tonight.headline: 0-5, and Week 5 was lost by 5.4 with 22.3 on the bench
body: Bad news first: Kings of the North finished at 131.84 to your 126.44. Golden scored 20.3 on your bench behind Tate's 1.6 — the projection's coin flip, not an override.
Week 6 is Los Cachanillas (2-3), projected 78.8 with the Vikings' defence on bye. As set you project 112.2; the projection lineup is 117.2. Golden into Tate's slot is the move that matters.

case.label: Why you are favoured
case.body: Their projection carries a 0.0 defence and Montgomery is week-to-week. ESPN gives you 69% on the lineup as set.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Rice inactive and Pickens forgotten, or Chicago starting Bagent, which caps Loveland.

doFirst.title: Start Golden, bench Tate
doFirst.subtitle: 16.1 against 11.9 — a projection gap, not a coin flip. Last week's coin flip between them cost 18.7.

case.label: The gap
case.body: 4.2 points, outside the two-point line. This is the projection lineup, not a hunch.

case.label: The player
case.body: Golden: 123 yards last week, Love healthy, Dallas 25th against receivers. Tate: limited by his back last Thursday, one catch on five targets, and Indianapolis are a middling 18th.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tate outscores Golden in Week 6 (archive).

doFirst.title: Rice into the flex for Pickens, if he is active
doFirst.subtitle: A 0.8 coin flip that goes to the projection. Pickens plays Sunday night, so he is the fallback.

case.label: The call
case.body: 14.5 against 13.7: inside the coin-flip line, so the projection decides and no thesis is written.

case.label: The doubt
case.body: Rice's hamstring is 'relatively minor' (Rapoport) but no practice report exists until Wednesday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Rice limited all week or ruled out: Pickens stays. Either way, decide at 12:55 Sunday.

whatWentWrong.title: The receiver coin flip lost Week 5

case.label: From the archive
case.body: 22.3 left on the bench: Golden for Tate 18.7, Gordon for Taylor 3.6. Neither from an override. This week the same pair is not a coin flip: 4.2 to Golden.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing to undo — the first card sets Golden.

whatWentWrong.title: The tight-end seat is closed until Wednesday afternoon
whatWentWrong.lead: Loveland's QB is undecided; Strange is on waivers.

case.label: The rule
case.body: You swapped Strange for Loveland at 15:52 UTC on 7 Oct; the churn rule keeps that seat closed for seven days.

case.label: When to act
case.body: After 15:52 UTC Wednesday, if Chicago name Bagent the starter for Atlanta, add Strange (a free agent once claims run) for Loveland.
